experiment_type: Paired 10-episode training diagnosis; no deterministic evaluation

criteria.descriptive_effect_size_rule: Strong support requires both return-volatility ratios <=0.80, at least two of three Macro variability ratios <=0.80, no material Critic EV drop (>0.10), and nonzero Joint Micro drift. No significance test is used.

15_limitations: Only 10 paired training realizations from one training pool and one initial checkpoint; results are descriptive, not a generalization or significance claim.
The Freeze treatment removes Micro Actor/Critic optimizer updates while preserving stochastic Micro actions; it does not establish that Micro learning is the sole source of Macro instability.
Episode-to-episode correlations use 9 lag-aligned observations or 10 same-episode observations and are descriptive only.
No deterministic evaluation was run, and no algorithm or hyperparameter was changed.

One extra Joint episode_20016 rollout was collected and discarded before any update because of a report-harness digest-key alias; total accepted training episodes remain 10 per branch, with 21 full collection attempts overall.

16_next_step.next_step: 停止，等待确认是否扩展到 20 对 episode。

1_experimental_setup.discarded_attempt_detail: One Joint episode_20016 collection was discarded before any optimizer update because the diagnostic comparator initially expected slot_reward_sequence_digest while the 5D-0 artifact used reward_sequence_digest. All three reward/Macro/Micro digests matched after the alias was corrected. It is excluded from the 10 trained Joint episodes.
